subject.title: [Bug]: Hallucination Loop — Agent Generated Irrelevant Multi-Thousand-Word Responses Across 2 Simultaneous Sessions

question: Should this incident be treated as supported shared-DM configuration, a default/session-isolation bug, a delivery replay bug, or a new semantic runaway-output safety guard?
rationale: The evidence proves a real Telegram send burst and shared-DM-session precondition, but not a single current-main defect; each plausible fix has different compatibility and product consequences.

options.title: Keep as config/support boundary
options.body: Document and recommend per-channel-peer DM isolation for multi-user Telegram bots, and close only if maintainers decide the shared main session is expected behavior here.

options.title: Change the session boundary
options.body: Make Telegram or all direct-message sessions isolate by peer by default or through a migration, accepting an upgrade-impact review.

options.title: Keep open for bounded investigation
options.body: Correlate the diagnostics with current session, delivery, and transcript behavior before choosing whether to patch routing, replay recovery, or semantic output containment.

recommendation.title: Keep open for bounded investigation
recommendation.body: Correlate the diagnostics with current session, delivery, and transcript behavior before choosing whether to patch routing, replay recovery, or semantic output containment.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the Telegram release path, session-scope docs, and recent adjacent direct-session fixes where vincentkoc has concrete history.
